g.text: Is now the time that I can finally admit how utterly fascinating I find you and this situation you have found yourself in?
[Confess Feelings.] Roathe? I... don't know if this is a good time, but...
Yes? What is it? Ah, judging by your overuse of ellipsis you are about to confess something dire and embarrassing. Allow me to guess! This will be an entertaining game.
Well, look at you. Look at all this effort you've made to clean up Albrecht's mess. But not only that, you come to collect payment in such a... unique way.

As you wait for the next signal from Albrecht.
Indeed, you went so far as to strike a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection.
As you wait for the next signal from Albrecht.

Oraz, zgodnie z twoimi przewidywaniami, znów wpakowałeś się w kłopoty z wybranką swojego serca, Marią, czyż nie, Uzurpatorze? W każdym razie diabeł znów przybywa z pomocą, zgodnie z warunkami naszej umowy.

And, as you predicted you might, you painted yourself into a corner with your chosen prey; Lyon. (Though I honestly do not know how you managed it.) No matter. The devil is here to save you, per our contract.
You're implying that what I feel for her isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.
You're implying that what I feel for him isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.

If I did not know your true motivations behind it, I would be sitting here applauding you for your entrepreneurial spirit. Making the best of one's situation, and all that. But to know what truly spurred you on? Love? I find it difficult to be my usual acerbic self.
Każda inna osoba, mająca mniej optymistyczne podejście do życia, mogłaby ocenić twoje... przedsiębiorcze zachowanie w równie negatywnym świetle.
Nie chcę o tym rozmawiać z tobą, Roathe.
Which you correctly predicted you would need. As you have been quite the belligerent pain in my arse.
When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
When you say it like that, this all sounds disgusting.
Hardly! I would applaud you if we were sitting in the same room, Drifter dear. You have simply made the best of your situation.

You're implying that what I feel for you isn't real. You couldn't be farther from the truth.
Then, go. I do not chain you to your chair.

You aren't exactly the easiest person to navigate speaking to.
Can we skip past the lectures?

It is natural. I find myself even coming to hate the zealots a little bit less the longer I am forced to spend in their presence. It is infuriating.

Zgodnie z naszą umową jestem zmuszony ci wybaczyć, więc nie rozumiem, dlaczego marnujesz czas na przeprosiny. Niemniej zostają one docenione.

Zgodnie z naszą umową jestem zmuszony ci wybaczyć, ale kontrakt nic nie wspomina o pozostawieniu twojej głowy w jedności z resztą ciała. Zalecam, żebyś uważał na słowa podczas naszej dalszej współpracy.

Więc równie dobrze możesz skorzystać, póki masz taką możliwość.

A więc tak się stanie. Zobaczę, co zdołam sprawić, aby przyspieszyć sprawy między wami. Ale kiedy tego dokonam, w twoim obowiązku będzie leżeć... sfinalizowanie tej transakcji. Nie zaprowadzę was za ręce przez całą drogę.

Answer me a question, however. I am dying of curiosity. Does she deliver homilies during coitus?

Your striking a bargain with me to ensure I would give you a chance to garner my affections, coupled with your confession, paints the act as one of pure desperation. Even more tragic you did not need to use it.
Indeed, you went so far as to strike a bargain with me to ensure that you could not fail in garnering my affection, even though in the end you did not require it.
Ale jeśli życzysz sobie... pospieszenia tej sprawy. Byłbym niedbały, gdybym nie zapytał, czy twoje stanowisko pozostaje niezmienione?
I am so glad you understand. Thank you.
I have something to confess. The reason I... wiped everyone's minds clean, was because I had to try again with you.
I'm sorry, but I've... I've changed my mind. I don't really love you.

Myślę, że blefujesz. Wątpię, żebyś w ogóle wiedział, czego ode mnie chcesz.

You have accidentally caused a rift in time that is collapsing as we speak and we are all utterly doomed and only have seconds to live before we are all sent screaming into eternity as we are agonizingly ripped apart as our very beings are stretched to incomprehensible lengths down to the subatomic particles?

Uważam, że największym osiągnięciem Imperium Orokin była jego zdolność przekonania swoich obywateli do wiary we własne idee.
Well, I for one would not mind in the slightest, as you can very likely tell by this conversation. I doubt the zealots would either.
